title: Walk hills or stairs 25 minutes
steps: Warm up on flat ground for 5 minutes.
Walk up a gentle slope or one flight of stairs at a steady pace.
Come back down slowly with small steps.
Repeat the climb 3 to 5 times, resting on the flat in between.
Cool down on flat ground for the last 5 minutes.
Hold a rail on the stairs if you feel unsteady at any point.
mistakes: Leaning back on the way downhill.
Taking stairs two at a time before you are ready.
